reference_algorithm: src/mo_capo.py, MO-CAPO Algorithms 1 and 2 supplied by the user

algorithm_components.initialization: Initial instructions plus 0..kmax few shots, one common random search block
algorithm_components.variation: Original CAPO perform_crossover and perform_mutation; no adaptive Tri-Fair editor
algorithm_components.intensification: Progressive random blocks from incumbent intersection; compare on improvement or at common-basis completion; nearest-incumbent early rejection
algorithm_components.mixed_fidelity: Rejected challengers retain partial evaluations in the non-incumbent population; survivors need only the current common basis
algorithm_components.parent_selection: Incumbent priority, crowding distance, equal-set NDS/CD, subset weaker dominance, random fallback
algorithm_components.environmental_selection: Preferential non-incumbent removal; identical sets use NDS/CD, differing sets remove fewest evaluations; incumbent-only crowding on intersection
algorithm_components.incumbent_advancement: One least-evaluated incumbent, union gaps first, otherwise one new block
algorithm_components.distance_scaling: Observed global min/max for all three objectives

necessary_fairness_adaptations: Compute Macro-F1 and unfairness from pooled predictions over the union of the compared blocks, not an arithmetic average of nonlinear block scores.
Defer three-objective dominance and crowding decisions when fairness support is insufficient; retain provisional incumbents. This does not claim a confidence interval or statistical superiority.
At the last common block follow paper Algorithm 2 case (b): admit then recompute NDS. This differs from an early-rejection check at the last block in the current upstream implementation.
Canonicalize block sets so insertion order cannot change equal-fidelity comparisons.
Bound distinct-parent retries to avoid an infinite tournament loop.
Strict downstream accounting stops before an unaffordable atomic model call.

experiment_protocol.audit: Freeze terminal incumbent shortlist, complete full search coverage, then evaluate held-out validation. No audit-to-search feedback or continuation.
experiment_protocol.budget_fill_for_baselines: Existing v8.9 empty/duplicate/unaffordable retry wrapper; baseline selection rules unchanged
experiment_protocol.unused_reserve: Reported separately; an equal total ceiling is not equal actual expenditure
experiment_protocol.historical_partial_fronts: Saved in search logs, never presented as fully evaluated held-out trajectories
experiment_protocol.gpu: H200 family by default, batch-invariant engine and structured labels for every method

historical_methods: v8.9, v9.0 and v9.1 remain addressable for reproduction; their learned editing strategies are not inherited by v9.2
validation_limits: CPU control-flow, accounting and integration checks only. No GPU run or improved experimental quality is claimed. Original two-objective numerical identity is not claimed.
